name: add_visa_dependent
description: add_visa_dependent: Add a dependent to an existing visa petition. Returns an amendment_id on success.

employee_id.description: The employee's ID. Format: EMP followed by 6 digits. Example: EMP081034

visa_petition_number.description: The visa petition number. Format: 3 uppercase letters followed by 10 digits. Example: WAC2512045678

dependent_first_name.description: The dependent's first name, 2-30 characters, letters and hyphens only. Example: Priya, Jean-Luc

dependent_last_name.description: The dependent's last name, 2-30 characters, letters and hyphens only. Example: Sharma, Dupont

relationship.description: The dependent's relationship to the employee

dependent_date_of_birth.description: The dependent's date of birth in YYYY-MM-DD format. Example: 2024-03-15

dependent_country_of_birth.description: The 2-letter ISO country code for the dependent's country of birth. Convert country names to codes. Example: IN, US, MX

uscis_receipt_number.description: The USCIS receipt number for the petition amendment. Format: 3 uppercase letters followed by 10 digits. This is a different identifier from the visa petition number. Example: IOE0912345678
